description: This file contains service functions for managing trainers, their availability, and bookings within a gym management system. It includes create, update, delete, list, and booking operations, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM models.

methods.name: Trainer create_trainer(db: Session, name: str, bio: str | None)
methods.description: Creates a new trainer record in the database with provided name and optional bio.

methods.name: Trainer update_trainer(db: Session, trainer_id: int, **fields)
methods.description: Updates attributes of an existing trainer identified by trainer_id.

methods.name: None delete_trainer(db: Session, trainer_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes the trainer with the specified trainer_id.

methods.name: list[Trainer] list_trainers(db: Session)
methods.description: Returns a list of all trainers.

methods.name: TrainerAvailability add_availability(db: Session, trainer_id: int, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime)
methods.description: Adds an availability time slot for a specified trainer.

methods.name: list[TrainerAvailability] list_availability(db: Session, trainer_id: int)
methods.description: Lists all availability slots for a given trainer, ordered by start time.

methods.name: TrainerBooking create_trainer_booking(db: Session, user_id: int, trainer_id: int, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime)
methods.description: Creates a booking for a trainer with validations for availability and conflicting bookings.

methods.name: TrainerBooking cancel_trainer_booking(db: Session, user_id: int, booking_id: int, is_admin: bool = False)
methods.description: Cancels an existing trainer booking if the requester has permission.

ctags.pattern: /^def add_availability(db: Session, trainer_id: int, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime) -> /
ctags.signature: (db: Session, trainer_id: int, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime)

ctags.pattern: /^def cancel_trainer_booking(db: Session, user_id: int, booking_id: int, is_admin: bool = False) -/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, user_id: int, booking_id: int, is_admin: bool = False)

ctags.pattern: /^def create_trainer(db: Session, name: str, bio: str | None) -> Trainer:$/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, name: str, bio: str | None)

ctags.pattern: /^def create_trainer_booking(db: Session, user_id: int, trainer_id: int, start_time: datetime, end/
